**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The document contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding Sparkling:

- **§ 3 Restrictions on Use** (p0030–p0039) is confined to licence-scope conduct: no copying beyond backup/internal purposes, no assignment/sublicence, no reverse engineering, no use of "the Work" except as authorized, and no service-bureau use for third parties (with an affiliate carve-out). None of these limits the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy, build or license.
- **§ 2 Grant** is expressly "non-transferable and **non-exclusive**", so Garman holds no exclusivity that could block our own products or brands.
- **§ 16 escrow licence** (p0115) affirmatively lets us change, update and improve the Software for our own operations — the opposite of a no-build restriction.
- Targeted searches for "compete", competing products, field-of-use, territory, and develop/market/sell restrictions returned nothing binding us; **§ 19** is a mutual *employee non-solicitation*, which belongs to the non-solicitation rule and is not double-flagged here.

No redline proposed.
